blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: A stack is last-in, first-out (LIFO). Push places a value on top, Pop removes the top, and Peek reads without removing.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A stack can support undo histories and recursive call frames. The physical call stack is a related example but not this Stack<T> collection.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Always check Count or otherwise handle an empty-stack exception before Pop/Peek.
